title: Sovra Phase 01 Domain Schemas (FTF-0102 — Organization/Workspace)
description: Frozen shared domain schemas for the tenant-root entities (Section 6.1/6.2). Field constraints (patterns, lengths, enums) are copied verbatim from the single real enforcing source, apps/api/app/auth/organization_workspace_schema.py, and tested against it directly in tests/tasks/test_ftf_0102.py so this file cannot silently drift from the code that actually validates these shapes.

Slug.description: Lowercase alphanumeric with internal hyphens only; no leading/trailing hyphen.

Organization.description: Section 6.1 — the tenant root. Every tenant-scoped row traces to one.

Workspace.description: Section 6.2 — tenant-scoped under its parent Organization. (organization_id, slug) is unique; slug alone is not.
